title: News and current affairs from Germany and around the world
content:
The world is watching to see if a fragile ceasefire between Iran and the US will last. The war has severely disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

A vehicle drove into a crowd at Berlin's Pride festival Saturday night, killing one and injuring at least 29.
